basis.prefix: Cluster::new(3, 3) builds three OmniPaxos instances (pids 1,2,3) over shared MemoryStorage handles, then pump_until(2000) ticks/routes until a leader (Leader, Accept) exists; three entries 0,1,2 are appended on that leader and pump_until(4000) waits until every node reports decided_idx == 3. followers are sorted and the two non-leaders are named v (stale node) and f (healthy follower).
